title: Gateway Energy Storage System: Phase 56H Evidence Decision
summary: The current CPUC GO 167-C catalog continues to expose Gateway's June 2, 2025 audit report and facility response, but no later final incident finding or full-capacity restoration record is listed. Phase 56H decision: No closure change. A current catalog check confirms the available audit rail but not final investigation closure or restored operation.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Final investigation and full contracted-capacity restoration.
Continuation rule: Reopen when CPUC, EPA, CAISO, SCE, or the operator publishes final findings or a full-capacity operating record.
why_it_matters: The record tests a named acquisition or reopening rule while keeping adjacent context separate from exact operating, corrective-action, or closure evidence.
ftfn_relevance: Records the official rail, compatible observation, and decision at a date.
Separates evidence-state movement from entity performance, quality, readiness, or value.
evidence_limits: Catalog presence and a prior audit-response pair do not establish final incident findings, dispatch, availability, or restored contracted capacity.
Final investigation, full return to service, contracted-capacity restoration, availability, dispatch, duration, degradation, revenue, and reliability effects.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
